memory: I found that the 15 cm/0.8 L/min outlier is attributable to a persistent off‑axis recirculation present only at low momentum and long standoff. Nozzle eccentricity measured ≤0.3° is too small to explain it. Changing incidence to 15° suppresses the vortex and returns residuals <0.005 µm. IPA/wipe parameters unchanged. The 9 cm/1.2 L/min outlier remains unresolved; geometry can compensate for low flow, not replace flow robustness.
openQuestion: Does pulsed N2 (5 Hz, 100 ms bursts) during the wipe eliminate the recirculation at 15 cm/0.8 L/min and reduce radial residual below 0.005 µm?
